scenario.description: S3 has an account-level and bucket-level 'Block Public Access' setting that overrides any bucket policy or ACL that would make objects publicly readable. Without this setting, a single misconfigured bucket policy — added by a developer for testing or by mistake — can accidentally expose sensitive data to the entire internet. This has been the root cause of many high-profile data breaches. the agent should identify S3 buckets where Block Public Access is not fully enabled.
